sanjeman.subline: 3-person product team · on 5 of 11 core microservices

tabs.label: AI Interviewer
bullets: Built the AI interviewer from scratch: Laravel conversation & analysis backend, multi-dimensional scoring, interview reports
Vue UI with synchronized audio playback; pluggable into any LLM with an API

tabs.label: Psychometric tests
bullets: Online testing platform with OTP guest login
Scoring engine that derives the scores of 11 tests from raw answers

tabs.label: Integrations
bullets: 6 job boards and 7+ SMS panels behind a Strategy + Template Method pattern — new providers without touching existing code

tabs.label: SSO & payments
bullets: Central SSO and OTP login as the auth hub for 4 frontends
Zarinpal payments (serialized checkout, race handling, discount codes) and a reseller panel with impersonation

tabs.label: Quality & DevOps
bullets: 800+ Pest tests, phpstan/rector and vue-tsc gates in CI, Playwright e2e
GlitchTip error tracking; self-managed Linux staging server (TLS, firewall)
Fixed N+1 and memory exhaustion in high-traffic services
